page.overview:
Who is Durrom?

Durrom of the Emerald Eyes was the lord of the aboleth city of Salar and master of its surviving brood of dozens or perhaps hundreds of aboleths. As of 836 PD, it oversees the brood as it expands its army of thralls and learns about the surface world, with the ultimate goal of shattering the forgotten Pillars of the Earth that support Emon and collapsing the city into its subterranean domain.

So far, Durrom has not appeared or been mentioned onstream.

In the original Tal'Dorei Campaign Setting, set in 812 PD, this character was called "Overseer Durrom", and the Pillars of the Earth were said to support the surface of Tal'Dorei, rather than clarifying that, with Salar being directly underneath Emon, and the twisting pillars coming up from Salar, only Emon would be affected.
